scenarios.title: 周一早上聊周末
scenarios.setting: 周一早上九点，你在茶水间接咖啡，碰到隔壁组的 Jake。他是美国人，话多又随意，周末去露营了。你想自然地聊上几句，而不是一句话就把天聊死。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Jake
turns.en: Hey hey! Morning. Man, I am not awake yet. How was your weekend? Get up to anything fun?
turns.zh: 嘿！早啊。天，我还没醒呢。周末过得怎么样？干什么好玩的了吗？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说周末过得不错，没什么特别的：周六带孩子去了动物园，周日就在家歇着。然后反过来问他。
turns.en: Morning! Pretty good, thanks. Nothing special — we took the kids to the zoo on Saturday, and on Sunday I just took it easy at home. How about you?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Jake
turns.en: Nice, nice. We went camping up by the lake. It was awesome until, like, two a.m., when it started pouring, and it turns out our tent is not waterproof. At all.
turns.zh: 不错不错。我们去湖边露营了。一开始特别棒，结果半夜两点左右开始下暴雨，才发现我们的帐篷不防水。一点都不防。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你表示同情，觉得听起来真够惨的。问他们后来怎么办的，最后是不是只能睡在车里。
turns.en: Oh no, that sounds rough! So what did you do? Did you end up sleeping in the car?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Jake
turns.en: Yup. Four of us and a wet dog in a Honda. My back is destroyed. Anyway — the zoo! How old are your kids again? Did they love it?
turns.zh: 没错。四个人加一条湿漉漉的狗，挤在一辆本田里。我的腰废了。不说这个——动物园！你家孩子多大来着？他们喜欢吗？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说一个五岁一个八岁。小的看到企鹅喜欢得不得了，怎么拉都不肯走；大的从头到尾都在抱怨，只想回家打游戏。感叹一句有他们俩你闲不下来。
turns.en: They're five and eight. The little one went crazy for the penguins — we couldn't drag her away. The older one complained the whole time and just wanted to go home and play video games. They keep me busy, that's for sure.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Jake
turns.en: Ha! Classic. Mine's the same, everything's 'boring' unless it has a screen. Hey, you guys should come camping with us sometime. In a better tent, I swear.
turns.zh: 哈！太典型了。我家那个也一样，没屏幕的东西全都“无聊”。对了，你们哪天应该跟我们一起去露营。我保证换个好点的帐篷。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说听起来很有意思，孩子们肯定喜欢。不过先说好，你从来没露过营，到时候全靠他了。再开个玩笑：你会先看天气预报。
turns.en: That sounds fun, the kids would love it. Fair warning, though: I've never been camping, so I'd be counting on you. And I'm checking the forecast first.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Jake
turns.en: Deal. Okay, I gotta grab this coffee and run — I've got a nine-fifteen. Good talking to you!
turns.zh: 说定了。好了，我得拿上咖啡赶紧走——九点一刻有个会。跟你聊天真开心！

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说好，那就不耽误他了，祝他开会顺利，回头见。
turns.en: Sure, I'll let you get back to it. Good luck with the meeting — catch you later!

chunks.term: I'll let you get back to it.
chunks.zh: 那我不耽误你了，你忙吧。

scenarios.title: 午饭时聊爱好和旅行
scenarios.setting: 周三中午在公司食堂，你和同组的 Yuki、Tunde 坐一桌。Yuki 下个月要休三周假，还没想好怎么安排；Tunde 说话爱抬杠。你想聊聊自己的旅行经历和爱好，顺便给点建议。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Yuki
turns.en: Oh my god, I can't wait for next month. Three weeks off! I'm thinking Vietnam, but I haven't booked a thing yet. Have either of you been?
turns.zh: 天哪，我等不及下个月了。三周的假！我在考虑去越南，但还什么都没订。你们俩谁去过吗？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说你去过，是前年去的，待了十天，非常喜欢。你强烈推荐会安：古城很漂亮，东西好吃还很便宜。
turns.en: I have, actually! I went the year before last and spent ten days there. I loved it. I'd definitely recommend Hoi An — the old town is beautiful, and the food is amazing and really cheap.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Tunde
turns.en: See, everyone says the food. But is it one of those places that's just rammed with tourists? Because I did Bali last year and, mate, never again.
turns.zh: 你看，人人都说吃的好。但那儿是不是那种挤满游客的地方？我去年去了巴厘岛，哥们儿，再也不去了。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说热门的地方确实人多，尤其是晚上。但只要早点起，或者往游客少的地方走一走，就很清静。你当时租了辆小摩托骑去周边的村子，那是整趟旅行最精彩的部分。
turns.en: The popular spots do get crowded, especially in the evening. But if you get up early or go a bit off the beaten track, it's really peaceful. I rented a scooter and rode out to the villages — that was the highlight of the trip.

chunks.zh: 游客少的、不那么热门的地方

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Yuki
turns.en: A scooter? Brave. I'd be terrified. So are you, like, a big traveller in general? Is that your thing?
turns.zh: 小摩托？真勇敢。换我得吓死。那你平时是那种特别爱旅行的人吗？这是你的爱好？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说其实算不上，一年最多出去一两次。你真正着迷的是摄影，旅行多半只是给自己找个拍照的理由。
turns.en: Not really — once or twice a year, at most. What I'm really into is photography. Honestly, the trips are mostly an excuse to take pictures.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Tunde
turns.en: Oh, nice. Proper camera, or are you one of those people who says 'photography' and means their phone?
turns.zh: 哦，不错。是正经相机，还是那种嘴上说“摄影”其实就是用手机拍的人？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你笑着说是正经相机，一台用了好多年的旧微单。不过你承认，现在手机拍得太好了，很多时候你都懒得带相机出门。
turns.en: Ha, a proper camera — an old mirrorless one I've had for years. Although I'll admit, phones have gotten so good that half the time I can't be bothered to carry it.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Yuki
turns.en: Okay, you have to show me your Vietnam photos. And can you send me the name of where you stayed? I'm hopeless at planning.
turns.zh: 好，你一定得给我看看你在越南拍的照片。还有，能把你住的地方的名字发我吗？我做计划简直没救。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说没问题，吃完饭就把照片和酒店发给她。再给她提个醒：如果下个月就走，机票最好尽快订，越拖只会越贵。
turns.en: Sure, I'll send you the photos and the hotel after lunch. One tip: if you're going next month, I'd book the flights soon. Prices only go up the longer you leave it.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Tunde
turns.en: She won't. She'll book it the night before and pay double, you watch.
turns.zh: 她才不会。她会拖到出发前一晚才订，然后付双倍的钱，你等着瞧。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Yuki
turns.en: Rude. Accurate, but rude.
turns.zh: 没礼貌。说得倒是准，但真没礼貌。

scenarios.title: 会议开始前等人时的寒暄
scenarios.setting: 周四晚上十点（伦敦是下午），跨团队的视频会议。你提前两分钟进了会，只有伦敦的产品经理 Charlotte 在，主讲人 Dev 还没到。你们俩不太熟，你要用天气、近况这类话题把这几分钟填上，别冷场。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Charlotte
turns.en: Oh, hi! Looks like it's just the two of us so far. Dev's running a few minutes late, I think — his last one overran. How's it going?
turns.zh: 哦，嗨！看来现在就我们俩。Dev 应该会晚几分钟——他上一个会拖堂了。你最近怎么样？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你跟她打招呼，说自己还不错，没什么可抱怨的。告诉她 Dev 晚到没关系，你也刚进来。然后问问伦敦那边怎么样，是不是已经冷了。
turns.en: Hi Charlotte! Can't complain, thanks. And no worries about Dev, I just joined myself. How are things in London? Is it cold yet?

chunks.zh: 还不错，没什么可抱怨的。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Charlotte
turns.en: Oh, don't ask. It's freezing out there, and it's dark by four. Typical November. I've basically forgotten what the sun looks like. How about you? Where are you based again?
turns.zh: 哦，别提了。外面冷得要命，四点天就黑了。典型的十一月。我都快忘了太阳长什么样了。你呢？你是在哪儿办公来着？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说你常驻上海。今天这边天气其实特别好，凉爽又晴朗。现在是这里一年中最舒服的时候，所以大家都在抓紧享受。
turns.en: I'm based in Shanghai. It was really nice out today, actually — cool and sunny. This is the best time of the year here, so we're making the most of it.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Charlotte
turns.en: Ugh, jealous. Wait, so what time is it for you right now? It must be getting late.
turns.zh: 唉，羡慕。等等，那你那边现在几点了？应该挺晚了吧。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说现在快晚上十点了。不过你不介意，已经习惯了，而且这样你早上可以晚一点开始工作。
turns.en: It's almost ten p.m. I don't mind, though. I'm used to it by now, and it means I can start a bit later in the morning.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Charlotte
turns.en: Ten! Oh, you poor thing. We really need to find a better slot for this. Any plans for the weekend, at least?
turns.zh: 十点！哎呀，真是辛苦你了。我们真得给这个会找个更好的时间。至少周末有什么安排吧？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说没什么安排，大概就是补补觉，再刷刷剧。然后反问她周末打算去哪儿。
turns.en: Not much, really. I'll probably catch up on sleep and binge-watch something. What about you — are you going anywhere?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Charlotte
turns.en: My in-laws are visiting, so... pray for me. Kidding! Mostly. Oh — I think that's Dev joining now.
turns.zh: 我公公婆婆要来，所以……替我祈祷吧。开玩笑的！基本上是开玩笑。哦——好像是 Dev 进来了。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Dev
turns.en: Hi both, so sorry — back-to-back meetings all day. Did I miss anything?
turns.zh: 两位好，太抱歉了——今天一整天的会都是连着的。我错过什么了吗？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说没有，你们只是在闲聊。让他别着急，还有几个人没到，需要的话可以先缓一缓再开始。
turns.en: Not at all, we were just chatting. No rush — we're still waiting on a couple of people, so take a minute if you need it.

chunks.zh: 先缓一缓、花点时间准备

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Dev
turns.en: You're a lifesaver. Okay, give me ten seconds to share my screen, and we'll get going.
turns.zh: 你真是救了我。好，给我十秒钟共享屏幕，然后我们就开始。

scenarios.title: 同事休假回来
scenarios.setting: 周一上午，同事 Camille 休了两周假刚回来，晒黑了，正对着几百封未读邮件发愁。你路过她的座位，想问问她假期过得怎么样，告诉她这两周团队里发生了什么，并主动帮她分担一点。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Camille
turns.en: Oh là là. Four hundred and twelve unread emails. Why did I come back? Somebody remind me.
turns.zh: 我的天。四百一十二封未读邮件。我为什么要回来？谁来提醒我一下。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你欢迎她回来，夸她气色很好，晒出了一身漂亮的肤色。然后问她这趟旅行怎么样。
turns.en: Welcome back! You look great — you've got a proper tan. So, how was your trip?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Camille
turns.en: Honestly? It was heaven. Two weeks in Corsica, no laptop, just beach, hiking, and way too much cheese. I didn't think about work once. Well — maybe once.
turns.zh: 说实话？简直是天堂。在科西嘉待了两周，没带电脑，就是海滩、徒步，还有吃不完的奶酪。我一次都没想过工作。好吧——可能想过一次。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说太羡慕了，你都不记得自己上次请几天假、彻底把工作放下是什么时候了。问她：要是你哪天也去，有什么是绝对不能错过的。
turns.en: I'm so jealous. I can't remember the last time I took a few days off and properly switched off. If I ever go, what's the one thing I shouldn't miss?

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Camille
turns.en: The mountains, not the beaches. Everybody goes for the beaches. Anyway — tell me the truth. What did I miss? Is everything on fire?
turns.zh: 去山里，别去海滩。人人都奔着海滩去。不说这个了——跟我说实话，我错过了什么？是不是到处都着火了？

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你让她放心，没出什么大事。主要有两件：搜索功能的上线推迟了一周；另外 Ben 调去了平台组，所以他的代码评审暂时由你顶着。
turns.en: Nothing's on fire, don't worry. Two main things: the search launch got pushed back a week, and Ben moved to the platform team, so I'm covering for him on code reviews for now.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Camille
turns.en: Wait, Ben left the team? Nobody told me! Okay, that's... a lot. And my dashboard project — please tell me nobody touched it.
turns.zh: 等等，Ben 离开我们组了？没人告诉我啊！好吧，这……信息量有点大。那我的仪表盘项目呢——拜托告诉我没人动过它。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你告诉她没人动过，跟她走的时候一模一样。不过设计那边上周留了一些意见，你已经替她整理了一份简短的摘要，省得她在收件箱里一封封翻。
turns.en: Nobody touched it, it's exactly how you left it. Design did leave some comments last week, though, so I put together a short summary for you. That way you don't have to dig through your inbox.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Camille
turns.en: You did not. You are an angel. Okay, I owe you one. Actually, I owe you several.
turns.zh: 不会吧。你真是个天使。好，我欠你一个人情。不对，欠你好几个。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说小事一桩。劝她今天别想着把所有事都补上，慢慢找回状态。你十一点左右正好想喝杯咖啡，叫她一起，到时候把剩下的情况讲给她听。
turns.en: Happy to help. Don't try to catch up on everything today — ease back into it. I could use a coffee around eleven, so join me and I'll fill you in on the rest.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Camille
turns.en: Perfect. Eleven. Oh, and I brought chocolate from the airport. It's on my desk — help yourself before the others find it.
turns.zh: 太好了。十一点。哦对了，我从机场带了巧克力，就在我桌上——趁别人还没发现，你自己拿。

scenarios.title: 下班前婉拒邀请并改约吃饭
scenarios.setting: 周五下午五点半。热情的意大利同事 Luca 和南非同事 Zanele 在招呼大家下班去街角新开的酒吧喝一杯。你今晚得去接孩子、回家吃饭，去不了，但你不想显得不合群，想改约下周一起吃晚饭。

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Luca
turns.en: Okay, laptops closed, people! We're heading to that new place on the corner for a drink. You're coming, right? Don't even think about saying no.
turns.zh: 好了，各位，合上电脑！我们要去街角新开的那家喝一杯。你来的吧？想都别想说不。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说你很想去，但今晚去不了：你得去接孩子，还答应了要回家吃晚饭。表示抱歉，时间实在不凑巧。
turns.en: I'd love to, but I can't make it tonight. I have to pick up the kids, and I promised I'd be home for dinner. Sorry, bad timing!

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Luca
turns.en: Come on, one drink! Twenty minutes. The kids will survive.
turns.zh: 来嘛，就一杯！二十分钟。孩子们不会有事的。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你笑着不上当：你太清楚跟他喝“一杯”是怎么回事了，从来不止一杯。今晚是真的不行，但你说改天一定补上。
turns.en: Ha, nice try. I know how 'one drink' goes with you — it's never just one. I really can't tonight, but I'll take a rain check.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Zanele
turns.en: Leave them alone, Luca. Honestly, though, we never see you outside the office. We should fix that.
turns.zh: 别为难人家了，Luca。不过说真的，出了办公室我们就从来见不到你。这个得改改。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你承认她说得对，你最近在这方面确实做得不好。你提议下周找个晚上一起去吃顿饭，你请客，算是弥补今晚。
turns.en: You're right, I've been pretty bad at this lately. How about we grab a bite one night next week instead? It's on me, to make up for tonight.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Zanele
turns.en: Ooh, now we're talking. I'm free Wednesday or Thursday. Luca?
turns.zh: 哦，这才像话嘛。我周三或周四有空。Luca 呢？

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Luca
turns.en: Thursday. Wednesday is football. But I choose the restaurant — no offence, but last time you picked that salad place.
turns.zh: 周四。周三我要看球。但是餐厅我来选——别见怪啊，上次你挑的是那家沙拉店。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说周四你可以。同意让他来挑餐厅，但半开玩笑地提醒他别选太高档的，毕竟掏钱的是你。
turns.en: Thursday works for me. Fine, you pick — but nothing too fancy. Remember, I'm the one paying.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Luca
turns.en: No promises. I'll send a few options to the group chat tonight. Well — tomorrow. After the drinks.
turns.zh: 这我可不保证。我今晚往群里发几个选项。呃——明天吧。等喝完酒。

turns.speaker: me
turns.zh: 你说好，你会留意群里的消息。祝他们今晚玩得开心，周末愉快，周一见。
turns.en: Sounds good, I'll keep an eye out for it. Have fun tonight, and have a good weekend! See you Monday.

turns.speaker: them
turns.name: Zanele
turns.en: You too! Say hi to the family for us.
turns.zh: 你也是！替我们向你家人问好。
